Fact: compute_methodology
What to find: Methodology used to measure or estimate training computation.
Card sections that often contain it: Compute, FLOPs

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Training computation is reported as GPU hours on H100-80GB (TDP 700W) hardware, defined as the total GPU time required for training each model. The card points to a linked methodology (arxiv.org/pdf/2204.05149) for training energy use and greenhouse gas emissions.
quotes: Training time is the total GPU time required for training each model and power consumption is the peak power capacity per GPU device used, adjusted for power usage efficiency.
The methodology used to determine training energy use and greenhouse gas emissions can be found here (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2204.05149).
Model pre-training utilized a cumulative of 7.38M GPU hours of computation on H100-80GB (TDP of 700W) type hardware, per the table below.
